# mergegateway_routing_policy (Resource)

Manages an organization routing policy. Requests route with it by sending its `model` (`@alias/<slug>`) as the model.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A PRIORITY policy: try gpt-4o first, then gpt-4o-mini. Requests route with
# it by sending "@alias/fast-fallback" as the model.
resource "mergegateway_routing_policy" "fast_fallback" {
  name        = "Fast fallback"
  description = "gpt-4o with gpt-4o-mini as a fallback"
  slug        = "fast-fallback"
  strategy    = "PRIORITY"

  priority_order = [
    { model = "openai/gpt-4o", priority = 1 },
    { model = "openai/gpt-4o-mini", priority = 2 },
  ]
}

# An INTELLIGENT policy that picks the cheapest suitable model.
resource "mergegateway_routing_policy" "cheapest" {
  name           = "Cheapest"
  strategy       = "INTELLIGENT"
  axis           = "COST"
  allowed_models = ["openai/gpt-4o", "openai/gpt-4o-mini"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The routing policy's name.
- `strategy` (String) `PRIORITY` tries the models in `priority_order`; `INTELLIGENT` picks among `allowed_models` along `axis`.

### Optional

- `allowed_models` (List of String) `INTELLIGENT` only. The models to choose from, each listed once. Every model must have a capability tier: the API drops models without one, and the provider reports that as an error.
- `axis` (String) `INTELLIGENT` only. What to optimize for: `COST`, `PERFORMANCE` or `CAPABILITY`. Defaults to `COST`.
- `description` (String) A description of the routing policy. Leave it out for none.
- `priority_order` (Attributes Set) `PRIORITY` only. The models to try, each listed once; lower `priority` is tried first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--priority_order))
- `slug` (String) The policy's handle, used in `model`. Changing it renames the handle. 3 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, `.`, `_` or `-`, starting and ending with a letter or digit; `default_routing` and `fusion` are reserved. It must not be taken by another policy or model alias. When left out, Merge Gateway picks one or leaves it unset; removing it later keeps the current slug, since the API can't clear it.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_providers` (List of String) `INTELLIGENT` only. The providers of `allowed_models`, sorted.
- `created_at` (String) When the routing policy was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) The routing policy's ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the organization's default routing policy. The organization's first policy becomes the default; this resource doesn't change it.
- `model` (String) The value to send as `model` in a request to route with this policy, such as `@alias/<slug>`.
- `modified_at` (String) When the routing policy was last changed (RFC 3339).

<a id="nestedatt--priority_order"></a>
### Nested Schema for `priority_order`

Required:

- `model` (String) The model.
- `priority` (Number) The model's priority.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a routing policy by its ID.
terraform import mergegateway_routing_policy.fast_fallback 3d7c2a10-5b4e-4f6a-9c1d-2e8f7a6b5c44
```
